purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign030 mechanism without opening a Campaign030 minute partition, frozen market benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does a stock's signed one-minute return coupling to the leave-one-out broad market weaken rather than strengthen from the morning half to the afternoon half?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A decline in common-market coupling into the close can indicate that morning common-liquidity pressure has resolved and stock-specific price formation has resumed. Higher morning-to-afternoon coupling resolution may therefore be associated with better resilience from the next open through the third close.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use the 119 adjacent close returns inside 09:31-11:30 as the morning block and the 119 adjacent close returns inside 13:01-15:00 as the afternoon block. Match every stock return only to the same fixed position of its leave-one-out market mean. Exclude standalone 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, lead-lag, cross-half, and selected-subwindow transitions.
known_design_risks: correlation versus beta, covariance or residual variance; morning-minus-afternoon versus absolute instability; direction; peer threshold; and half-session boundary are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the statistic may be associated with overall market idiosyncrasy or market-sign asymmetry even though it measures a different morning-to-afternoon state change
declining market coupling can mean common-shock resolution or delayed market information incorporation, so the higher morning-minus-afternoon direction must be frozen before returns
using absolute returns, market signs, leads or lags, subwindows, fitted residual drift, amount or volume weights, terminal factor values, or cross-sectional dispersion would change the mechanism

rejected_concepts.reason: Negative absolute morning-afternoon correlation difference would answer exposure stability rather than common-shock resolution and has no preregistered directional decay hypothesis.
Beta and residual variance would materially overlap the terminal market-idiosyncratic-share family and introduce scale fitting absent from the selected correlation-state mechanism.
Market-sign asymmetry and response-delay asymmetry are already terminal Campaign026 and Campaign021 mechanisms.
Campaign030 must be one new raw stock-plus-market statistic; Campaign029 cannot be rescued by lowering cost, filtering, combining, or changing its formula.
